## Projects Department Health &Safety Standards

Ref:EGY/PRJCTS/HSE/REQs

## 2.4.1.2. Role of Managers and Supervisors:

- >All managers and supervisors have a role to play in delivering the strongest of health and safety cultures across all project sites.
- To help achieve this the following list illustrates the expected behaviors for these groups to help shape the culture of theirpeers and workforce:
- Demonstrating active engagement with the Emaar's Zero harm philosophy and approach
- Setling high standards of health and safetyperformance and behavior
- Ensuring that persons for whom they are responsible are aware and accurately informed of their ownhealth andsafetyresponsibilities and accountabilities
- Challenging poor health and safety performance and personally taking action when they see a breach of rules or unsafe working practices, however small
- Ensuring thatapurposefuland clearcommunication systemis establishedbetween themselves andtheirworkforce
- Ensuring compliance with, and support of health and safety plans, audits, visits or inspections
- P Taking part in, and personally contributing to health and safety events,meetings and campaigns
- Promoting and implementing health and safety programs that support the Beyond Zero philosophy
- Leadership traits to shape the organizational Culture are expanded upon below.

## 2.4.1.3. Leadership:

- A Good leadership is integral to the development of a positive Health & Safety culture and is recognized as making a vital contribution to achieving excellent performance.A positive H&S follow.
- A key element of health and safety leadership is about what people DO rather than what they SAY. Simply put, saying the right thing but not doing the right thing will not produce the desired results.
- Top Class heaith and safety leadership involves the following key factors:
- ·Visibly demonstrating that there is nothing more important than the health, safety and welfare of employees
- Communicating commitment to health and safety in a compelling way and setting a personal exampleforotherstofollow
- Committing the necessary resources (people, equipment, systems, information and time) to strengthen.the healtir safety culture and tocrcate a sustainable'Zero Harm'workplace C
